scope: First exploratory feasibility loop, not publication Gate-F/P5; prior pilot may select window.
no_tuning: One fixed budget/version, final checkpoint only; no model selection on new evaluation data.
event_definition: Mz +/-0.6, completion after160 reduced time units
fair_budget: All learned models same600 updates,8 paths/update and backbone; compare also empirical trajectory resampling.
stopping_rule: Large held-out error or failure against resampling => stop scale-up; wide CI => inconclusive, not GO
